title: With precedence, a+a*a has one tree
notes: One variable per level of precedence: E for sums, T for products, F for single factors. The * can only sit lower in the tree than the +, so a+a*a has exactly one tree, and the search proves it by running out of forms.
ops: E -> E+T | T; T -> T*F | F; F -> (E) | a
